Class PlayEventVisitor

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.visitors.PlayEventVisitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardVisitor
public class PlayEventVisitor extends Object implements CardVisitor
Visitor that executes event cards during the event phase of a round.

Implements the Visitor pattern on CardVisitor: visits event cards and executes their effects on all players. Feast events (CardTypeEnum.FEAST) are deferred and executed last via feastIfPresent(), ensuring they are always resolved after all other events.
